verdict.rationale: Crossmint's docs describe per-agent scoped delegation on agent wallets: each agent gets its own signer key bound to a spend cap, allowed counterparties, and a time window, all enforced onchain and revocable by the user at any time. Agent cards are order intents with a fixed allowance, expiration, merchant lock, and tracked spent/available amounts. They stop working when cancelled, expired, or fully spent, and are described as scoped and revocable. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation of the revocation API and its latency (whether revocation takes effect instantly)
